cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?
